meta.name: Monty Python's Flying Circus
meta.description: A British sketch comedy series with the shows being composed of surreality, risqué or innuendo-laden humour, sight gags and observational sketches without punchlines.

videos.title: Whither Canada?
videos.overview: Featuring 'It's Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart', an Italian lesson, Whizzo Butter, 'It's the Arts', Arthur 'Two-Sheds' Jackson, a cycling race, and The Funniest Joke in the World.

videos.title: Sex and Violence
videos.overview: Featuring some flying sheep, a man with three buttocks, a man with two noses, musical mice, a marriage guidance counsellor, a working-class playwright and The Wrestling Epilogue.

videos.title: How to Recognise Different Types of Trees from Quite a Long Way Away
videos.overview: Featuring a court scene, the larch, Bicycle Repair Man, children's stories, a restaurant sketch, some seduced milkmen, an interview with some children and a stolen newsreader.

videos.title: Owl Stretching Time
videos.overview: Featuring fresh fruit as self-defence, some folk-singing, an art gallery sketch and Lemming of the BDA. An Edwardian man struggles to undress on the beach.

videos.title: Man's Crisis of Identity in the Latter Half of the 20th Century
videos.overview: Featuring Confuse-a-Cat, discussion programme A Duck, a Cat and a Lizard, the arrest of a newsreader, an erotic film, a silly job interview and a burglar/encyclopaedia salesman.

videos.title: It's the Arts
videos.overview: Featuring a gang of legal burglars, the Whizzo Quality Assortment, a Scottish wedding and a day in the life of a city stockbroker. Some film moguls try to impress their boss.

videos.title: Oh, You're No Fun Anymore
videos.overview: Featuring camel-spotting, an embezzler at a board-meeting and a science fiction tale about a Scotsman and a tennis-playing blancmange.

videos.title: Full Frontal Nudity
videos.overview: Featuring an art critic, some hermits, Hell's Grannies and the dead parrot sketch. Some newlyweds attempt to buy a bed and the mafia offer protecting to the army.

videos.title: The Ant, An Introduction
videos.overview: Featuring Ken Buddha, a man with a tape-recorder up his nose and a hairdresser who always wanted to be a lumberjack.

videos.title: Untitled
videos.overview: Featuring a bank robber in a lingerie shop, It's A Tree (with Arthur Tree), a vocational guidance counsellor, Ron Obvious and a gorilla librarian.

videos.title: The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra Goes to the Bathroom
videos.overview: The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra goes to the bathroom, a footballer is interviewed and Batley Townswomen's Guild re-enact the invasion of Pearl Harbour.

videos.title: The Naked Ant
videos.overview: Featuring the North Minehead by-election, the Upper Class Twit of the Year competition, Ken Shabby and a Party Political Broadcast on behalf of the Wood Party.

videos.title: Intermission
videos.overview: Featuring some historical impersonations, a cinema usherette with a dead seabird, restaurant abuse and Probe Around On Crime.

videos.title: Face the Press
videos.overview: Featuring Doug and Dinsdale Piranha, Face the Press and the Ministry of Silly Walks. Mrs G Pinnet buys a new gas cooker.

videos.title: The Spanish Inquisition
videos.overview: Featuring the Spanish Inquisition, courtroom charades and a semaphore interpretation of Wuthering Heights.

videos.title: Déjà Vu
videos.overview: Featuring the work of the poet Euan McTeagle, a psychiatrist milkman and some exploding animals. A television presenter suffers from a severe case of deja vu.

videos.title: The Buzz Aldrin Show
videos.overview: More surreal humour from the Monty Python team. Sketches include The Architects, How to Recognise a Mason, Poets and the Chemist sketch.

videos.title: Live from the Grill-O-Mat
videos.overview: Featuring gameshow Blackmail, The Society for Putting Things on Top of Other Things, Seven Brides for Seven Brothers and boxer Ken Clean-Air System.

videos.title: It's a Living
videos.overview: Featuring It's a Living and a school prize-giving. Timmy Williams presents a new chat show and the fate of the Silly Party hangs in the balance in an Election Night Special.

videos.title: The Attila the Hun Show
videos.overview: Featuring the Attila the Hun Show, a rat catcher, a village idiot, some killer sheep and news for parrots.

videos.title: Archaeology Today
videos.overview: Featuring Mrs Beethoven, the Reverend Arthur Belling, some Australian Mosquito Hunters and a drink party with the Gits.

videos.title: How to Recognise Different Parts of the Body
videos.overview: Featuring a guide on how to recognise parts of the body, a singing policeman, an interview with a plastic surgeon, a camp soldiers' drill and the Verrifast Plane Company.

videos.title: Scott of the Antarctic
videos.overview: Featuring a special report into the shooting of Scott of the Antarctic, from Paignton. Also, a man tries to purchase a fish licence.

videos.title: How Not to Be Seen
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as Job Hunter, Railway Timetables, How Not to be Seen and Interview in a Filing Cabinet.

videos.title: Spam
videos.overview: The sketches in this episode include Dirty Hungarian Phrasebook, World Forum-Communist Quiz, Hospital for Over-Actors and Spam.

videos.title: Royal Episode 13
videos.overview: Sketches in this episode include How to Feed a Goldfish, The Man Who Says Things in a Very Roundabout Way and Lifeboat.

videos.title: Whicker's World
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as Multiple Murderer Court Scene, Njorl's Saga and Whicker’s World.

videos.title: Mr. and Mrs. Brian Norris' Ford Popular
videos.overview: Features Emigration from Surbiton to Hounslow, The Fish Slapping Dance, SS Mother Goose, Trim-Jeans Theatre and some very famous guests.

videos.title: The Money Programme
videos.overview: Features The Money Programme, Erizabeth L, Dead Bishop, Jungle Restaurant and The Argument Skit.

videos.title: Blood, Devastation, Death, War and Horror
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as Blood, Devastation, Death, War and Horror, The Man who Speaks in Anagrams and Pantomime Horses.

videos.title: The All-England Summarise Proust Competition
videos.overview: Featuring in this episode The All-England Summarise Proust Competition, Fire Brigade, Travel Agent and Party Hints with Veronica Smalls.

videos.title: The War Against Pornography
videos.overview: Sketches in this episode include Tory Housewives Clean-up Campaign, Gumby Brain Specialist, Expedition to Lake Pahoe and The Silliest Interview We've Ever Had.

videos.title: Salad Days
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as Biggles Dictates a Letter, Climbing the North Face of the Uxbridge Road, Lifeboat and The Cheese Shop.

videos.title: The Cycling Tour
videos.overview: This episode tells the story of Mr Pither as he embarks on his Cycling Tour.

videos.title: The Nude Organist
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as Bomb on Plane, Mortuary Hour, The Olympic Hide-and-Seek Final, The Cheap Laughs and Prices on the Planet Algon.

videos.title: E. Henry Thripshaw's Disease
videos.overview: Sketches include The Tudor Jobs Agency, Elizabethan Pornography Smugglers, Thripshaw's Disease and The Man Who Says Words in the Wrong Order.

videos.title: Dennis Moore
videos.overview: Features the sketches Dennis Moore, What the Stars Foretell, The Ideal Loon Exhibition, Off-Licence and Prejudice.

videos.title: A Book at Bedtime
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as A Book at Bedtime, Kamikaze Scotsmen, No Time to Lose, Spot the Looney and Frontiers of Medicine-Penguins.

videos.title: Grandstand (or: The British Showbiz Awards)
videos.overview: Sketches include The Oscar Wilde Sketch, David Niven’s Fridge, Pasolini’s ‘The Third Test Match’, New Brain from Currys, Blood Donor and the Dirty Vicar Sketch.

videos.title: The Golden Age of Ballooning
videos.overview: Features gags and sketches such as The Golden Age of Ballooning, Louis XVI, The Court of George III and a Party Political Broadcast on Behalf of the Norwegian Party.

videos.title: Michael Ellis
videos.overview: Features the sketches Department Store, Buying an Ant, At Home with the Ant and Other Pets and Toupee Department.

videos.title: The Light Entertainment War
videos.overview: More surreal gags and sketches including Up Your Pavement, RAF Banter, Court Martial, The Public Are Idiots and Woody and Tinny Words.

videos.title: Hamlet
videos.overview: Sketches in this episode include Hamlet and Ophelia, Bogus Psychiatrists, Police Helmets, Boxing Match Aftermath and The Queen Victoria Handicap.

videos.title: Mr. Neutron
videos.overview: Featuring the story of Mr. Neutron and sketches including Post-Box Ceremony and Teddy Salad.

videos.title: Party Political Broadcast
videos.overview: Sketches in this final episode include The Most Awful Family in Britain, Patient Abuse, Brigadier and Bishop and The Man Who Finishes Other People's Sentences.
